screen.projecthero.suit_call.remote_pilo: Remote Pilot: deploy this suit as a drone and fly it from where you stand. Your body stays behind, unprotected, and any hit on it drops the link. Range 96 blocks. C ends the link and the suit flies home.
message.projecthero.ironman.drone.linked: Remote link established: %s. C ends the link.
message.projecthero.ironman.drone.alread: You already have a suit out on remote.
message.projecthero.ironman.drone.wearin: Take your suit off before piloting %s remotely.
message.projecthero.ironman.drone.not_fu: Remote Pilot needs the whole %s in your pack or on a nearby platform.
message.projecthero.ironman.drone.no_ene: %s has no charge for a remote link.
message.projecthero.ironman.drone.ended: Remote link closed. %s is flying home.
message.projecthero.ironman.drone.hurt: You were hit and the remote link dropped. %s is flying home.
message.projecthero.ironman.drone.docked: Your pack is full: %s landed at your feet.
message.projecthero.ironman.drone.blocke: %s could not find a way back and landed as pieces at %s, %s, %s.
message.projecthero.ironman.drone.destro: %s was destroyed! Its pieces fell at %s, %s, %s.
message.projecthero.ironman.drone.no_pow: %s ran out of power and fell. Its pieces are at %s, %s, %s.
hud.projecthero.drone.title: REMOTE LINK
hud.projecthero.drone.hint: WASD fly, Jump / Sneak up / down, Sprint boost, Click or R fire, C end link
